PROVENANCE

Sources & methodology

Seven curated fragrances and ten offers were manually captured on September 14, 2026 from linked retailer or brand pages. Product names, concentrations, sizes, notes and listed prices remain attributable through each catalog record.

Coverage is deliberately small. “Best” means highest transparent match within this catalog, not best in the global market. Availability is not monitored live.

Retail sources

Ulta Beauty, Sephora Canada and Kohl’s / Sephora. Every purchase link points directly to the recorded retailer page. One-time listed prices are used; subscription prices, coupons, taxes, delivery costs, gifts and membership benefits are excluded.

Matching weights

20 base points, up to 35 family points, 25 liked-note points, 10 occasion points, 10 intensity points and 5 affordability points, with a 10-point over-budget penalty. Exact disliked-note matches are removed before scoring. Ties break by price per mL and stable ID.

Limitations

Retailer note lists are selective marketing descriptions, not full formulas. No claim is made about allergens, longevity, authenticity beyond the linked retailer, personal preference or stock at checkout. Exchange rates are not used; each country displays its native offer currency.

Image

The unbranded fragrance still-life is original AI-generated artwork. It does not depict or endorse any catalog product.
